description: Signing in to Claude from the chat: /login (or Sign in on a turn that failed for want of it) runs claude auth login and shows its progress in an amber-bordered card in the chat; a turn that fails because Claude Code isn't signed in shows a card with Sign in.
opens: /login (optionally with claude auth login's arguments) sent in the composer
Sign in on the not-signed-in card

parts.name: not-signed-in card
parts.shows: Amber-bordered box (1px warning colour, 8px corners, 8px/12px padding): "Claude Code isn't signed in" in bold, then dimmed (60%) the first 200 characters of why; under it a "Sign in" button (accent).

actions.does: Removes this card and adds the sign-in card.

parts.name: sign-in card
parts.shows: Same amber box. A bold title line, a body line under it, then a row: a text field filling the width (placeholder "If the page shows a code, paste it here"), "Send", "Cancel".
text: If the page shows a code, paste it here

actions.by: Enter in the field / click Send
actions.does: Passes the pasted code to the sign-in; the body says "Checking the code…".
Opens the sign-in page in the browser.

states.name: starting
states.shows: "Signing in to Claude…" / dimmed "Starting the sign-in…".

states.name: browser opened
states.shows: Body: "A browser window should have opened to sign in. If it didn't, open the sign-in page." (the last words a link).

states.name: checking
states.shows: Body: "Checking the code…" after a code is sent; "Signed in; checking who as…" once it succeeds. The field row goes.

states.name: signed in
states.shows: "Signed in to Claude" / "as <account>" (or dimmed "claude auth status didn't say who as"); the chat's claude restarts on the new sign-in (after the turn if one runs).

states.name: failed
states.shows: "Sign-in didn't finish" / dimmed reason, and a "Try again" button (accent).

states.name: another machine's chat
states.shows: No card: a quiet note "<host>'s claude signs in there: run claude auth login on it" (or, for a failed turn, "<host>'s claude isn't signed in: run claude auth login on it").

states.name: /logout
states.shows: Quiet notes: "signing out…" then "signed out of Claude" or "sign-out failed: <why>".
